description: This file defines the EmacsBehavior class, a mixin for adding Emacs-style keyboard shortcuts to Kivy's TextInput widget, including key bindings, shortcut handling, and editing methods.

classes.name: EmacsBehavior
classes.description: A mixin class that enables Emacs-style keyboard shortcuts for TextInput widgets in Kivy.

methods.name: keyboard_on_key_down
methods.description: Handles key down events, executing Emacs shortcuts if applicable.

methods.name: delete_word_right
methods.description: Deletes text from the cursor to the end of the current word.

methods.name: delete_word_left
methods.description: Deletes text from the cursor to the start of the current word.
